end.summary:
Practised linking harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready.
Discussed festival celebrations through food, clothes, lamps, and flowers.
Kavya named Diwali, Holi, Makar Sankranti, and Christmas.
The idea that festival dates are random remained uncorrected after the last attempt.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting harvest festivals to farming and seasons, and describing celebrations using food, clothes, decorations, and flowers. Kavya gave details about Diwali celebrations, including new clothes, diyas, sweets, and flowers. They continued to mix up harvest festivals with festivals happening at any time; this was not corrected by the end. At home, use a simple calendar to match Makar Sankranti or another harvest festival with the crop-harvesting season.
